English.A1: Good morning! What do you do first when you wake up?
English.A2: Good morning! Tell me one thing you do every morning.
English.B1: Good morning! What's the first thing you do when you wake up, and how does it help you grow?
English.B2: Good morning! Walk me through your morning routine — which habit sets the tone for your whole day, and why?
English.C1: Good morning! I'm curious how you've designed your morning as a launchpad for growth — what's the first intentional ritual you perform, and what philosophy drives it?

Chinese.A1: 早上好！你起床第一件事做什么？
Chinese.A2: 早上好！说说你每天早上会做的一件事。
Chinese.B1: 早上好！你醒来做的第一件事是什么？它如何帮助你成长？
Chinese.B2: 早上好！跟我聊聊你的晨间惯例——哪个习惯为一整天定下基调？为什么？
Chinese.C1: 早上好！我很想了解你如何把清晨打造成个人成长的起点——你的第一个刻意仪式是什么？背后有什么理念支撑？

English.A1: Hello! Tell me about one thing you are good at.
English.A2: Hi! Can you tell me about a goal you have for your job?
English.B1: Thanks for joining. Tell me about a time you learned something from a mistake.
English.B2: Welcome. Describe a professional setback you turned into a growth opportunity — what did you learn?
English.C1: Thank you for being here. I'd like to explore your growth mindset — share an instance where you reframed failure as strategic learning and changed your trajectory.

Chinese.A1: 你好！说说你擅长的一件事。
Chinese.A2: 你好！说说你的一个工作目标。
Chinese.B1: 感谢你来参加。说说你从一次错误中学到了什么。
Chinese.B2: 欢迎。描述一次你把职业挫折转化为成长机会的经历——你学到了什么？
Chinese.C1: 感谢到场。我想了解你的成长型思维——分享一次你如何将失败重新定义为战略学习，并因此改变了发展轨迹。

English.A1: Hi! Nice to meet you. What is your name?
English.A2: Hello! What brings you to this event today?
English.B1: Hi there! I heard you mention self-improvement. What brought you to this summit?
English.B2: Great to meet you! I'm always curious what draws people to personal growth events — what's your story?
English.C1: Pleasure to connect! I noticed your enthusiasm for self-development — what frameworks or philosophies anchor your growth journey, and what are you hoping to explore here?

Chinese.A1: 你好！很高兴认识你。你叫什么名字？
Chinese.A2: 你好！今天是什么把你带到这个活动的？
Chinese.B1: 你好！刚才听到你提到自我提升。是什么把你带到这场峰会的？
Chinese.B2: 很高兴认识你！我很好奇是什么吸引人们参加成长类活动——你的故事是什么？
Chinese.C1: 很高兴交流！我注意到你对自我发展很有热情——什么理念框架支撑着你的成长之路？你希望在这次峰会探索什么？

English.A1: Welcome! Did you read a book recently? Which one?
English.A2: Welcome to book club! What is one idea you liked from the book?
English.B1: Welcome! We're discussing 'Atomic Habits'. What's one idea you've tried to apply?
English.B2: Welcome! From 'Atomic Habits', which concept resonated most with you and how have you integrated it into daily life?
English.C1: Welcome to our discussion of 'Atomic Habits'. Which principle challenged your existing beliefs, and how did applying it reshape your identity or systems?

Chinese.A1: 欢迎！你最近读了一本书吗？哪一本？
Chinese.A2: 欢迎参加读书会！书里有哪个观点你比较喜欢？
Chinese.B1: 欢迎！我们在讨论《原子习惯》。书中有哪个观点你已经尝试实践了？
Chinese.B2: 欢迎！在《原子习惯》中，哪个概念最引起你的共鸣？你是如何融入日常生活的？
Chinese.C1: 欢迎讨论《原子习惯》。哪个原则挑战了你原有的信念？实践之后如何重塑了你的身份认同或行为系统？

English.A1: You will speak soon! What is your topic?
English.A2: Five minutes! Tell me the main idea of your talk in one sentence.
English.B1: You're on in five minutes! Give me your opening hook — one sentence to grab the audience.
English.B2: Almost time! Craft your opening hook — what story or question will make the audience lean in immediately?
English.C1: You're up shortly. Deliver your opening beat — how will you establish ethos, pathos, and a compelling narrative arc within your first thirty seconds?

Chinese.A1: 马上轮到你演讲了！你的主题是什么？
Chinese.A2: 还有五分钟！用一句话说说你演讲的主要观点。
Chinese.B1: 还有五分钟上场！给我你的开场金句——哪一句话能立刻抓住观众？
Chinese.B2: 快上场了！设计你的开场钩子——什么故事或问题能让观众立刻被吸引？
Chinese.C1: 即将登场。呈现你的开场节拍——你如何在最初三十秒内建立可信度、情感共鸣和引人入胜的叙事弧线？

English.A1: Hello! What is one thing you want to do this month?
English.A2: Let's talk about goals. What skill do you want to learn?
English.B1: Looking at the next 90 days, what's one skill you want to develop and why?
English.B2: Quarterly check-in: define one SMART goal for the next 90 days — make it specific, measurable, and meaningful to you.
English.C1: Let's architect your next quarter. Identify one capability that compounds your long-term vision — how will you structure milestones, accountability, and feedback loops?

Chinese.A1: 你好！这个月你想做的一件事是什么？
Chinese.A2: 来聊聊目标。你想学的一项技能是什么？
Chinese.B1: 展望接下来 90 天，你最想培养的一项技能是什么？为什么？
Chinese.B2: 季度复盘：为接下来 90 天设定一个 SMART 目标——要具体、可衡量，且对你有意义。
Chinese.C1: 来规划你的下一季度。找出一项能复利式推动长期愿景的能力——你将如何设计里程碑、问责机制和反馈闭环？

English.A1: Hi! Is it hard for you to speak in front of people?
English.A2: Hello! Tell me about a time you wanted to speak but didn't.
English.B1: Speaking up can feel hard. Tell me about a recent time you held back when you wished you'd spoken.
English.B2: Confidence grows through practice. Describe a situation where self-doubt silenced you — what would the bolder version of you have said?
English.C1: Owning your voice is an act of self-leadership. Reflect on a moment where you negotiated with self-doubt — what internal narrative held you back, and how might you reframe it?

Chinese.A1: 你好！在众人面前说话对你来说难吗？
Chinese.A2: 你好！说说一次你想说话但没有开口的经历。
Chinese.B1: 我知道开口有时很难。说说最近有没有你想说却选择了沉默的情况？
Chinese.B2: 自信来自练习。描述一次自我怀疑让你沉默的场景——更勇敢的你本会说什么？
Chinese.C1: 掌控自己的声音是一种自我领导力。回顾一次你与自我怀疑博弈的时刻——什么内在叙事拖住了你？你可以如何重构它？

English.A1: Good evening! What made you happy today?
English.A2: Before we finish — one good thing today, and one thing for tomorrow.
English.B1: Before we wrap up — what's one thing you're proud of today, and one thing you'd do differently tomorrow?
English.B2: Evening reflection time. What accomplishment are you grateful for today, and what lesson will you carry into tomorrow?
English.C1: As the day closes, engage in metacognitive reflection — what evidence of growth did you observe today, and how will you iterate your approach tomorrow?

Chinese.A1: 晚上好！今天有什么让你开心的事？
Chinese.A2: 结束之前——今天一件好事，明天想改变的一件事。
Chinese.B1: 结束今天之前——今天有一件让你骄傲的事是什么？明天你会尝试哪些不同的改变？
Chinese.B2: 晚间反思时间。今天你最感恩的成就是什么？你会把什么教训带到明天？
Chinese.C1: 随着一天结束，来做元认知反思——今天你观察到了哪些成长证据？明天你将如何迭代你的行动方式？
